ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by approximately 70% high-intensity white pixels on the lateral lobes and 30% low-intensity black pixels concentrated in the central hinge and trailing margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large contiguous high-intensity white blobs on the primary lobe surfaces. A low-intensity black inverted-V shape originates at the peduncle and tapers towards the notch. Multiple discrete black focal spots are scattered across the white regions, notably a cluster in the lower-right quadrant (image-view).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern; peaks and valleys are most pronounced on the distal thirds of both lobes, showing high pixel-amplitude variations against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex outer boundaries tapering into acute distal tips, with a transition to moderate concavity approaching the medial notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clustered, low-intensity pixel groups with irregular raised topography at both lobe tips, consistent with barnacle-related colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical, parallel low-intensity linear marks (rake marks) detected on the right lobe (image-view); several unaligned linear disruptions visible on the left lobe (image-view).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks across both ventral surfaces; distal tips show significant irregular edge loss and rough-textured scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, prominent vertical dark streak located in the medial section of the right lobe (image-view) and a concentrated dark spot near the lower boundary of the left lobe (image-view).
